Service Overview

Boiler Circulation Pump Specialists

Dependable support
for critical equipment.

Boiler Circulation Pumps operate in demanding power-generation environments where equipment reliability, correct assembly and dependable maintenance are essential. We understand the importance of a structured approach to inspection, repair and restoration.

Discuss a project
Inspection & repair support

Areas of Support

Practical expertise.
Project by project.

Service scope is assessed against equipment design, project requirements and site conditions.

01

BCP Repair & Overhauling

Inspection, dismantling, component assessment, repair and refurbishment of eligible pump assemblies.

Learn more
02

Glandless BCP Motor Services

Technical assessment, stator inspection and rewinding support, subject to equipment design and service requirements.

Learn more
03

Spare Parts & Reverse Engineering

Engineering assessment and development of replacement components for supported equipment, including parts that may be difficult to source.

Learn more
04

Technical Troubleshooting

Investigation of reported equipment issues and recommendations for appropriate corrective action.

Learn more
05

Engineering & Alternative Solutions

Evaluation of technically suitable repair, restoration and replacement options to support equipment reliability and lifecycle value.

Learn more
06

On-Site Technical Support

Assistance for inspection, maintenance and repair activities, depending on project requirements and site conditions.

Supporting Customers & Service Partners

A technical resource
for your project.

DEI VOX works with power-sector customers and welcomes project-based collaboration with international service companies and engineering organisations seeking specialist BCP aftermarket support and other agreed markets.

We understand that service partners need a dependable technical resource that can complement their customer relationships, support project execution and help address equipment-specific challenges.

Depending on the project, DEI VOX can discuss repair and overhaul support, motor-related services, engineered spare parts, technical assessments and coordinated execution arrangements. Each collaboration is defined by its agreed scope, responsibilities and commercial terms.
